decisions.reason: The high-resolution piezo inkjet printer sits close to the firm's core offer and is still early in its market life with unresolved but promising prospects, so keeping this option open costs little.

The software numbering module has a low carrying cost, builds on the existing printer base and fits the firm's serialization and digitalization strategy, so its option value clearly exceeds the cost of keeping it.

The inkjet coder for non-absorbent surfaces extends established technology into a demanding application where demand is still unfolding, so there is no evidence yet that its value will fail to materialize.
